children: On October 23, 2026, Nasdaq notified Medicus Pharma that it had regained compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(2), after closing bids remained at or above $1.00 for 10 consecutive business days from October 12 through October 23. Nasdaq closed the matter, superseding its October 20 delisting determination; the company cautioned that it may not maintain compliance with Nasdaq's listing requirements.
